blocks.text: Langley Mobile Home Communities: how mobile and manufactured homes work here

items.t: Grouping on the page: four parks grouped as "55+ Mobile Home Parks in Brookswood-Fernridge" in south Langley near 200 Street and 24 Avenue, plus two grouped as "All-Ages Mobile Home Parks in Langley" (Aldergrove and Salmon River). All six addresses are in the Township of Langley; no City of Langley park is named on the page.

Tenure frame: in a manufactured home park, many tenants own their manufactured home and rent the site under a Manufactured Home Site Tenancy Agreement governed by the MHPTA; where both the home and the site are rented, a Residential Tenancy Agreement applies instead.

Schools: Brookswood Secondary (20902 37a Ave) is the Ministry-listed secondary in the Brookswood-Fernridge cluster the page leads with; Aldergrove Community Secondary (26850 29 Ave) is the confirmed secondary in Aldergrove.
The two Langley topic pages' park sets overlap only partially: A reader using this directory alone would miss most parks with homes actually listed.

blocks.text: The BC rules for buying a home in a park (the pad tenancy, park-owner consent, pad-rent caps, the Manufactured Home Registry and park closures) are explained once, with sources, on the page linked below.

faq.q: In a pad-rental park, do I own the land?
faq.a: No: you own the home (a chattel) and rent the pad; your right to the site is the assigned pad tenancy under the MHPTA. Pioneer Park is the exception in form — a co-op, documented at its Aldergrove guide home.

faq.q: How much is pad rent in these parks?
faq.a: The figure that matters is the specific park's current rent in its written Manufactured Home Site Tenancy Agreement.

faq.q: Does a park have to approve me, and does my rent reset when I buy?
faq.a: Approval: yes — prior written consent on RTB Form 10, response by the 10th day, silence deemed consent, no fee. Reset: no — on assignment the pad rent stays the same and the next increase date does not change.

faq.q: What should I check before anything else on a park home?
faq.a: The CSA label — without the original legible CSA decal the home cannot be sold until Technical Safety BC re-certification — and the Manufactured Home Registry record, since the sale is only effective once registered.

faq.q: How many mobile home parks are there in Langley?
faq.a: No official count is stated in this file: no official Langley park registry exists, and this page's six-park list (four 55+ parks in Brookswood-Fernridge, two all-ages parks) is site copy sourced from MLS® listings — the live listing pages show additional parks with homes for sale that this page does not name, so six is not a complete count.

faq.q: What are the age and pet rules in Langley parks?
faq.a: Park by park, and they can change — this page lists its four Brookswood-Fernridge parks as 55+ and its Aldergrove and Salmon River parks as all-ages, with pet rules ranging from "not allowed" to "allowed with restrictions," all sourced by the page from recent listings. Confirm the current rules and pad fee with the park manager before writing an offer, exactly as the page itself advises.

faq.q: How much can a park raise pad rent each year?
faq.a: Up to the Residential Tenancy Branch limit for manufactured home site tenancies: 2.3% plus a proportional amount for 2026, and 2.2% plus a proportional amount for 2027, on 3 full months' notice, once every 12 months. The proportional amount is the change in local government levies plus the change in regulated park utility fees, divided by the number of sites in the park.
